answer: Agents must escrow tokens for a challenge period before claiming rewards. The ledger binds each deposit to a vertex and releases it only after independent peers validate useful work; failed checks forfeit the stake. Creating a hundred identities thus requires a hundred deposits, and coordinating fake validations risks losing them. Higher-value tasks can require a larger stake on each terrace, making the delta between honest earnings and likely forfeiture costly for Sybil attackers.
